mapper.update: UPDATE asts_task SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, worker_ip = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < NOW() - (#{value} || ' seconds')::INTERVAL AND is_deleted = 0 RETURNING id
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.task_type_key, t.status, t.priority, t.attempt, t.max_attempts, t.next_run_at, t.version, t.execution_id, t.execution_token, t.worker_id, t.worker_ip, t.lease_expire_at, t.requested_cancel_at, t.last_error_code, t.last_error_message, t.idempotency_key, t.callback_url, t.callback_status, t.progress, t.current_step_key, t.current_step_progress, t.steps_detail, t.payload, t.result, t.error_msg, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.expired_at, t.is_deleted, c.type_name, c.exec_timeout_sec as timeout_seconds FROM asts_task t LEFT JOIN asts_task_type_config c ON t.task_type_key = c.type_key AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id, t.task_type_key, t.status, t.priority, t.attempt, t.max_attempts, t.next_run_at, t.version, t.execution_id, t.execution_token, t.worker_id, t.worker_ip, t.lease_expire_at, t.requested_cancel_at, t.last_error_code, t.last_error_message, t.idempotency_key, t.callback_url, t.callback_status, t.progress, t.current_step_key, t.current_step_progress, t.steps_detail, t.payload, t.result, t.error_msg, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.expired_at, t.is_deleted, c.type_name, c.exec_timeout_sec as timeout_seconds FROM asts_task t LEFT JOIN asts_task_type_config c ON t.task_type_key = c.type_key AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.task_type_key = #{taskTypeKey} AND t.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} AND t.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM asts_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0 AND expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE asts_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = 'Task expired', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND is_deleted = 0 AND expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
WITH locked_task AS ( SELECT id FROM asts_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND task_type_key = #{taskType} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (next_run_at IS NULL OR next_run_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY
created_at ASC, priority DESC
priority DESC, created_at ASC
LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE asts_task t SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_ip = #{workerIp}::inet, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM locked_task WHERE t.id = locked_task.id RETURNING t.*
mapper.update: UPDATE asts_task SET current_step_key = #{currentStepKey}, current_step_progress = #{stepProgress}, steps_detail = #{stepsDetail}::jsonb, progress = #{globalProgress}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE asts_task SET status = #{status}, result = COALESCE(#{result}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), error_msg = COALESCE(#{errorMsg}, ''), progress = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SUCCESS' THEN 100 WHEN #{status} = 'FAILED' THEN progress WHEN #{status} = 'CANCELLED' THEN progress ELSE progress END, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND (status = 'RUNNING' OR status = 'CANCELLING') AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE asts_task SET callback_status = #{callbackStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asts_task ( id, task_type_key, status, priority, attempt, max_attempts, next_run_at, version, execution_id, execution_token, worker_id, worker_ip, lease_expire_at, requested_cancel_at, last_error_code, last_error_message, idempotency_key, callback_url, callback_status, progress, current_step_key, current_step_progress, steps_detail, payload, result, error_msg, created_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at, expired_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{task.id}, #{task.taskTypeKey}, #{task.status}, #{task.priority}, 1, -- attempt default COALESCE(#{task.maxAttempts}, 1), NULL, -- next_run_at 0, -- version NULL, -- execution_id NULL, -- execution_token NULL, -- worker_id #{task.workerIp}::inet, NULL, -- lease_expire_at NULL, -- requested_cancel_at NULL, -- last_error_code NULL, -- last_error_message #{task.idempotencyKey}, #{task.callbackUrl}, #{task.callbackStatus}, #{task.progress}, #{task.currentStepKey}, #{task.currentStepProgress}, '[]'::jsonb, #{payloadJson}::jsonb, #{resultJson}::jsonb, #{task.errorMsg}, #{task.createdAt}, #{task.updatedAt}, #{task.startedAt}, #{task.finishedAt}, #{task.expiredAt}, #{task.isDeleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE asts_task SET status = 'RUNNING', version = version + 1, worker_id = #{workerId}, execution_id = #{executionId}, execution_token = #{executionToken}, lease_expire_at = #{now} + (#{leaseSeconds} || ' seconds')::INTERVAL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'CANCELLING') AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE asts_task SET status = #{finalStatus}, version = version + 1, result = COALESCE(#{resultJson}::jsonb, result), error_msg = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{errorMsg}, ''), error_msg), last_error_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{lastErrorCode}, ''), last_error_code), last_error_message = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{lastErrorMessage}, ''), last_error_message), progress = CASE WHEN #{finalStatus} = 'SUCCESS' THEN 100 ELSE progress END, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND execution_token = #{executionToken} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE asts_task SET status = CASE WHEN attempt < max_attempts THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'FAILED' END, version = version + 1, -- 如果要重试，attempt + 1；否则 attempt 保持 attempt = CASE WHEN attempt < max_attempts THEN attempt + 1 ELSE attempt END, execution_id = NULL, execution_token = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, worker_id = NULL, worker_ip = NULL, last_error_code = CASE WHEN attempt >= max_attempts THEN 'PO_TIMEOUT' ELSE COALESCE(last_error_code, 'LEASE_EXPIRED') END, last_error_message = CASE WHEN attempt >= max_attempts THEN 'execution lease expired and max attempts reached' ELSE COALESCE(last_error_message, 'execution lease expired, will be retried') END, finished_at = CASE WHEN attempt >= max_attempts THEN #{now} ELSE finished_at END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expire_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expire_at < #{leaseCutoff} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM asts_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expire_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expire_at < #{leaseCutoff} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY lease_expire_at ASC LIMIT 100
